archetypes.name: design-reporting
archetypes.rationale: Review cross-script wiring for terminal versus escalation report precedence.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the /design reporting integration across render-final-summary, design-publish, Step 3, and Split-path prose. Check that terminal failures win over escalation evidence, successful outcomes cannot consume stale terminal state, and operator-action skips remain non-filing but visible Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: tierb-safety
archetypes.rationale: Review bounded Tier B filing and sensitive corpus handling.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the generic stall-reporting profile, prefixed artifacts, cross-repo filing, and Tier B duplicate comments. Check path confinement, sensitive corpus propagation, root-cause templates, and log-tail avoidance for design-prefixed reports Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: kv-cleanliness
archetypes.rationale: Review machine-output and final-summary channel separation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on stdout contracts for design helpers and render-final-summary. Check that helper KVs stay in captured sidecars, final-summary output remains prefix-compatible with sidecar additions, and the new tests pin the intended machine-readable surfaces Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
